Body.Content:
Account planning gives sellers one place in Dynamics 365 Sales to decide what they want to achieve with an account, how they'll get there, and how they're tracking against it. The plan lives next to the account, reads live from CRM data, and moves through review and approval before it becomes the active plan for the period.

What's new

Draft with Sales Research Agent. The agent reads the account, its opportunities, seller notes, growth plays, and wallet sizes, then proposes objectives, targets, and actions with its reasoning. Nothing becomes part of the plan until the seller accepts it.

Objectives, targets, and actions. Targets roll up to objectives, and progress is calculated from linked opportunities and activities, not typed in.

Wallet share, stakeholders, competitors, and growth plays on the plan, kept current from CRM.

Approval. Sellers submit the plan to an approver; changes to an approved plan go live only after they're approved again.

Plan the next period by completing a plan and carrying objectives forward.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
